acceptance_criteria_satisfied.how: CgCommand3P dispatches createGroup exclusively on r.pageA (admin origin). check returns true only when !m.memberA && m.groupId === null (plus m.pubkeyA !== null defensively). No CgCommand3P('B'|'C') exists — group origination is restricted to A as a model precondition (design-decision #2).

InCommand3P(invitee: 'B'|'C') — the constructor takes only the invitee; the inviter is always A (inviteByNpub on r.pageA). check returns true only when m.memberA && m.groupId !== null && !m.actorIsMember(invitee).

The !m.actorIsMember(this.invitee) clause in InCommand3P.check excludes the already-a-member invite shape, so fast-check never generates a redundant re-invite. It is pruned by check(), not silently no-op'd at run time (VQ-S3-003).

LgCommand3P(actor: 'A'|'B'|'C') leaves via the actor's OWN page — the group-leave-btn/confirm clicks target r.page(this.actor). check requires the actor is a member with another member remaining (sole-member-leave guard); m.groupId persists for the remaining members.
FdCommand3P forgets a B-or-C leaf on r.pageA (admin). check = m.memberA && (m.memberB || m.memberC) && m.groupId !== null. K==1 → invitee non-member; K>1 → leaf count polled to K-1.
RdCommand3P(actor, name) renames a device row on the actor's OWN page (r.page(actor)). UI-local; check = m.actorIsMember(actor) && m.groupId !== null.

SwCommand3P switches r.pageA between E2E_BUNKER_URL (A) and E2E_BUNKER_B_URL (B) ONLY, alternating by comparing m.pubkeyA to cachedPubkeyA. An inline comment names AC-3P-SW-1 and states A↔C and B↔C switches are NOT generated (no Sw variant for C). check = m.groupId !== null. Admin-only/MIP-03 constraints are model preconditions, not runtime checks.

verification_questions_addressed.answer: CgCommand3P.check = !m.memberA && m.groupId === null && m.pubkeyA !== null. run() calls createGroup(r.pageA, name) and currentGroupId(r.pageA) — dispatch is on pageA only. There is no CgCommand3P for B or C.
InCommand3P constructor signature is (invitee: 'B'|'C'); the inviter is hard-wired to A (inviteByNpub on r.pageA). check = m.memberA && m.groupId !== null && !m.actorIsMember(this.invitee).

The already-a-member shape is excluded by the !m.actorIsMember(this.invitee) clause in check(), so the harness prunes it before generation. The run() body has no no-op fallthrough for a member-invitee — it always performs a real invite+join.

LgCommand3P(actor: ActorId); run() resolves page = r.page(this.actor) and performs the group-leave-btn + group-leave-confirm clicks on that page — each actor leaves through its own page, never a hard-coded pageA.

FdCommand3P.check = m.memberA && (m.memberB || m.memberC) && m.groupId !== null. run() forgets on r.pageA only; non-admin forget is not representable (there is no per-actor Fd command) — encoded as a model precondition.
RdCommand3P(actor, name); run() targets the first device-row textbox on r.page(this.actor) — the actor's own device. The rename is UI-local with no MLS/membership side effect.

SwCommand3P.run determines the target via onIdentityA = (m.pubkeyA === cachedPubkeyA); target is E2E_BUNKER_B_URL when on A, else E2E_BUNKER_URL — bunker A and bunker B only. The leading doc comment names AC-3P-SW-1 and states A↔C and B↔C are NOT generated and that there is no Sw variant for C.

MIP-03 admin-only constraints are model preconditions, not fc.pre() discards or runtime guards: there is simply no command that lets B/C invite (InCommand3P inviter is always A) and no per-actor Fd (forget runs only on A). Impossible admin actions are never generated, keeping random-action density high (design-decision #2).

Cg sets m.groupId/m.groupName/m.memberA=true and clears m.tasks; In sets m.memberB or m.memberC; Lg clears only the leaver's membership flag (m.groupId persists for remaining members); Fd clears an invitee's flag iff its last leaf is forgotten. Consistent with the S4 headline assertions.

LgCommand3P.check requires at least one OTHER actor to still be a member (others.some(actorIsMember)), mirroring the 2-party Lg remaining-member guard. The harness therefore never shrinks into a sole-member-leave (covered separately by forget-device-self.spec.ts) or a degenerate empty group.

SwCommand3P captures priorGroupIds into m.lastSwitched BEFORE switchIdentity, excluding the shared group when the post-switch identity is also a member (false-positive guard for assertS7). After the switch it updates m.pubkeyA from getPubkeyHex, clears m.memberA, and resets m.epochSequenceA — matching the 2-party SwCommand bookkeeping and what assertS7_3P expects in S4.

issues_encountered: Single-group divergence from the 2-party template: the 2-party Lg/Sw null the leaver's per-actor groupId, but the 3P model has one shared m.groupId that must survive for the remaining members. LgCommand3P therefore clears only the leaver's membership flag and never nulls m.groupId; SwCommand3P clears m.memberA but leaves m.groupId intact (the group is still real for the other identity). Documented inline.

SwCommand3P references the module-scope cachedPubkeyA and the E2E_BUNKER_URL/E2E_BUNKER_B_URL constants. cachedPubkeyA is declared later in the file (test-lifecycle section) but resolves correctly because the reference is inside a method body evaluated at run time, not at class-definition time. The bunker constants are imported at the top.
